WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> ''
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg
    FROM group_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_acl_igg, m.mean_avg
    FROM group_averages g
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean m
    WHERE g.avg_acl_igg > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT pattern,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_acl_igg - mean_avg AS above_mean,
       avg_acl_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM kept) AS from_kept_mean
FROM kept;
